import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
from ghidra.program.model.listing import Function
from ghidra.program.model.data import Undefined4DataType
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141218e30")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent at 0x141218e30")
out["sig_before"] = str(f.getSignature())
# set prototype so params are explicit (RCX,RDX,R8,R9 all qword + stack region)
tx = None
try:
    tx = prog.startTransaction("sig fix")
    dt = prog.getDataTypeManager()
    # simplest: make it take 4 qwords + unspecified stack
    from ghidra.program.model.data import PointerDataType, LongLongDataType, VoidDataType
    from ghidra.program.model.symbol import SourceType
    sig = f.getSignature()
    # create function definition
    from ghidra.program.model.data import FunctionDefinitionDataType
    from ghidra.program.model.data import ParameterDefinitionImpl
    from ghidra.program.database import function
    fdef = FunctionDefinitionDataType("half_timbering_sig")
    fdef.setReturnType(VoidDataType())
    p0 = ParameterDefinitionImpl("rcx", PointerDataType(), 0)
    p1 = ParameterDefinitionImpl("rdx", PointerDataType(), 1)
    p2 = ParameterDefinitionImpl("r8", PointerDataType(), 2)
    p3 = ParameterDefinitionImpl("r9", PointerDataType(), 3)
    fdef.addParameter(p0); fdef.addParameter(p1); fdef.addParameter(p2); fdef.addParameter(p3)
    f.setSignature(fdef, SourceType.USER_DEFINED)
    prog.endTransaction(tx, True)
    tx = None
    out["sig_after"] = str(f.getSignature())
    d = DecompInterface()
    try:
        d.openProgram(prog)
        res = d.decompileFunction(f, 300, monitor)
        if not res.decompileCompleted():
            out["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
        else:
            out["decompiled"] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
    finally:
        d.dispose()
finally:
    if tx is not None:
        prog.endTransaction(tx, False)
print(json.dumps(out))
